fact: INSTAD and stakeholders validated the draft third national statistics development strategy SNDS 3 (2025-2029) at a workshop held the day before publication, with formal adoption stated to be expected in the coming weeks; the work was financed with the World Bank.
PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): SNDS 2025-2029.
The World Bank's implementation report of October 2026 says its project supported the publication of the third SNDS for 2025-2029; no adoption date is given.

INSTAD and its technical and financial partners launched the preparation of SNDS-3 for 2025-2029 at a workshop in Djibouti in February 2025, with the World Bank represented; INSTAD had put earlier strategies in place in 2011 and 2018.
